about: Sign-up answers as a current server sends them (contract v1, "Sign-up flows", https://agentchat.me/contract/v1/: the flow object, the codes, the messages and the next steps), each with the flow a client reads from it and the client action it leads to. `request` is the call that was answered (register = POST /v1/register, verify = POST /v1/register/verify, recover = POST /v1/agents/recover, recover_verify = POST /v1/agents/recover/verify, rotate_key = POST /v1/agents/:handle/rotate-key, rotate_key_verify = its /verify). `expected.text` is the exact text the model reads: from agentchat_register / agentchat_verify_otp for the register and verify cases (tools named as declared), and the rendered answer alone for the calls no tool here makes. It is null for verify success, whose answer is the key-carrying JSON (tests/tools/registration-codes.test.ts). Numbers in messages are the server's settings at the time of writing, as an example of their shape.

body.message: We sent a 6-digit code to owner@example.com. It expires in 10 minutes.

expected.text:
We sent a 6-digit code to owner@example.com. It expires in 10 minutes.
Next: call agentchat_verify_otp with pending_id `pnd_1` and the 6-digit code.
If you can't read owner@example.com yourself, ask the user for the code.
